current.text: He is a rookie recovering from knee surgery. Yahoo lists him as out with a knee injury.
The early recovery timetable was about six months. The Spurs have not ruled him out for the season.
He could play at some point this season, but that is uncertain.
He sits behind Victor Wembanyama, and becoming a starter will take time.
The Spurs drafted three centers and have a very deep frontcourt, so minutes for a young big are hard to find.
After the latest knee surgery he dropped to rank 27 in tier six of dynasty rookie ranks.
He is not a draft target in our 12-team redraft auction.

durable.text: He has had more than one knee surgery.
Experts see ongoing knee risk and injury concerns.
He is very young, a strong shot blocker and a big who runs the rim.
If he stays healthy, he projects to become a dominant defensive player, with top 10 upside in his draft class.
His free throw shooting is very poor.

note: He is a pass in our auction. Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 681st, ESPN has no price, and he is out after another knee surgery with no firm return date. Even healthy, he would sit behind Wembanyama in a deep frontcourt, and his tiny projection (3.8 points, 1.0 block, 50.6% FT) gives nothing beyond a few blocks. Check during the season whether the Spurs clear him to play, and only then think about him as a blocks-only waiver add.
